dishes.name: Dresden Stollen
dishes.desc: Heavy fruit loaf with candied peel, almonds and a coat of butter and sugar. Dresden has baked it since the 15th century and guards the name.

dishes.name: Würzfleisch
dishes.desc: Ragout of diced meat in a sharp, creamy, cheese-topped sauce, served in small gratin dishes. A Saxon snack found in every Dresden pub.

dishes.name: Pulsnitz gingerbread
dishes.desc: Spiced honey gingerbread from Pulsnitz in Upper Lusatia, baked since 1558 and sold plain or with glaze and filling.

dishes.name: Quark with linseed oil
dishes.desc: Boiled potatoes in their skins with fresh quark and cold-pressed linseed oil. The classic Upper Lusatian farmhouse meal.

dishes.name: Saxon Switzerland trout
dishes.desc: River trout from the Elbe Sandstone hills, served blue, fried or smoked. A favorite lunch at inns around Pirna and Bad Schandau.
